verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own docs list passkey, magic link and email-otp as sign-in plugins, and the homepage shows passkey() configured as a plugin. A community user confirms the passkey plugin needed only about 7 lines of server code. missing for 10: dedicated plugin documentation for passkey/WebAuthn, magic link and email OTP flows in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of magic link and email OTP sign-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods

citations.quote: can easily be extended using plugins, such as: username, magic link, passkey, email-otp, and more.
Passkeys, magic links, API keys, JWTs, and more.
better-auth's passkey plugin, which is 7 lines of server code total with virtually no client API changes
